nom: RoC Retinol Correxion Night Cream for Deep Wrinkles

segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin report mixed outcomes: one in cold, dry conditions developed burns around the eyes after three nights, one with dry, sensitive skin had a severe reaction even at reduced frequency but kept using it every other night at the cost of redness, and one with very dry, hardened skin at 70 reports it feeling normal and soft again within a week, with only mild, manageable burning.
segments.combination: A combination-skin reviewer whose skin had shifted with age reports major improvements in glow, hydration and the balance between oily and dry areas over two weeks, alongside a strong fragrance she found off-putting at first.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are split: several report burning, a red mark, or an eye reaction strong enough to require stopping or cutting back to once or twice a week, while others, especially those who prepped their skin first, patch-tested, or started with a lower frequency, report zero redness or irritation alongside smoother, plumper skin.
segments.mature: Reviewers from their late 40s through 70s report visibly softer fine lines and wrinkles, often within one to three weeks, with several long-term users in their 70s describing consistently smooth, improved skin after years of use.

concerns.aging: The large majority of reviewers report visibly softer fine lines and wrinkles, often within one to three weeks, especially around the eyes and forehead or between the brows; several caution that deep wrinkles or sagging are only minimized rather than erased and that results fall short of a dramatic, Botox-like change.
concerns.dehydration: Several reviewers report the cream alone is drying, especially in the first weeks as skin adjusts, and recommend layering a moisturizer on top; others, particularly with continued use, describe it as hydrating without feeling greasy or coated.
concerns.redness: A recurring subset of reviewers, including several with sensitive or dry skin, report significant burning, redness or blistering strong enough to require stopping use or cutting back to once or twice a week, especially around the eyes; many others, including some who also describe their skin as sensitive, report no burning or irritation at all, particularly when introduced gradually or paired with a moisturizer.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer notes the retinol thins the skin somewhat and recommends pausing use before procedures like eyebrow waxing.
concerns.spots: A few reviewers report their age spots or hyperpigmentation lightened alongside their wrinkles, with results emerging gradually over several weeks.
concerns.blemishes: A few reviewers describe an initial purging period with breakouts in the first one to two weeks that subsides with continued use; one reports the product helped clear pimples when alternated with another night cream, while another reports new breakouts appearing about a week in.

aspects.libelle: Strong, perfume-like scent despite claims of no fragrance
Lightweight texture that absorbs without greasiness
Small amount needed, tube lasts a long time
Sometimes arrives with a broken seal or opened box
Good value versus pricier department-store retinol creams

extraits.texte: Horrendously terrible. I had a reaction to this cream (I have no known allergies other than eggs) and I’m very familiar with retinol and retinoid use. My eyes, cheeks, and neck turned bright red, became swollen and itchy. After 3 days since application, my face is finally not swollen, but now I have significant discoloration and wrinkles from dryness that were never there. I am 29 and was using this preventatively. It’s made me look 5 years older. The wrinkles pictured are new since the swelling subsided.

After 4 nights of use my skin started to burn with each use. I have sensitive skin and this product was too harsh for it. I’m bummed because it seems like a great product but my skin can’t handle it. I only used it under my eyes and quickly got a red burn mark.

While I do have access to medical grade skincare, I went with this retinol because it has a lower percentage of retinol and I have sensitive skin. I started use to target fine lines around my eyes, a deeper wrinkle on my forehead, and to reduce my pore size. I have used this product for right over 7 weeks daily at night. Some of the reviews mentioned excessive dryness/flakiness/redness. That is an anticipated reaction when starting a retinol as well as skin purging aka sudden breakouts. I experienced all of that around probably the 1.5 week mark and the symptoms stopped around the 3 week mark. Since then, I’ve had dryness (which is to be expected) and I’ve seen a huge change in the texture and radiance of my skin. I think this is a great starter retinol for someone with any skin type. I think it’s important to note that if you have deep wrinkles/sagging, this is not the retinol for you. This will not be strong enough to erase them. It can help to minimize them but you’ll need to look elsewhere to completely get rid of them. All in all, super happy with this product!! My skin is so much more vibrant after use.

extraits.titre: Found the trick for making this work with sensitive skin!
extraits.texte: I love this product for fighting wrinkles, but it is so harsh. I have sensitive/dry skin (which of course, shows wrinkles the most) and being of "that certain age," my skin is extra dry and sensitive. I used this religiously, but ended up with my eyes almost sealed shut from a reaction to it and my skin burned, even when I limited my use to once or twice a week. Got rid of the wrinkles, but also got rid of my skin!! I won't give up using it, because it is amazing on wrinkles, but I recommend not using it every night - use it a couple of nights on, then a couple of nights off. My face would be red after using it this way, but not burned. A friend of mine recommended another skin care product - she's into organic - and told me to try Bel Essence (comes in an oil or cream, I used both - I've been buying it from their website but it's available here too)( Bel Essence Anti Aging Treatment - Intensive All Natural Anti-Wrinkle, Facial Lift Skin Care Formula - 1.5oz ). This solved the reaction problem to Roc. Not only did it help my skin in general, but using it with Roc - no burning, no bad reactions. I talked to my doctor about it, and he told me that the natural oils in Bel Essence contain high amounts of Vitamin E and other nutrients that help the skin heal and stay healthy. If you love Roc (and I am a HUGE fan), I recommend using Bel Essence with it, to get the good effects of Roc without the bad. So far for my first retinol product to use it’s a gem! I’m 35 and live in west Texas (lots of sun and dirt is not skin’s friend). I have sensitive skin and generally am not great about washing and or moisturizing to begin with, so I was nervous about trying really any product especially one of skin strength. On reading, I notice many complain about the irritation they experience. I didn’t want that! So before starting in order to get my skin ready and healthy, I spent a week regularly washing with a gental cleanser, used a vitamin c serum, and moisturized, 2x daily. Highly suggest doing this! Next I used this product on specific places not my whole face to test. I picked the one main deep line on my forehead that brought me to this point in the first place. From Day 1 my skin felt smoother in that area and moisturized, zero redness or irritation across my forehead. I moved to the corners of my eyes and again no troubles. I know this product takes time but the depth of the line tested on my forehead, while not disappeared, feels plumped below and smoother. All the little ones around are already are improving. I don’t know if my skin was just dying for this help and extra attention but I LOVE everything going on. Since, I have also ordered the deep line filler as well as the serum keying in on all the retinol points, target-treat-moisturize! So far I’m very pleased and look forward to continuing use. Another point about this product. It is fragranced, it’s light, but there. If

I found myself growing desperate. At 70 years old, my skin was no longer responding to exfoliation. It was as if my skin was as dry as a desert bone and no amount of moisturizer would penetrate it. I thought to myself: 'So this is what it's like to turn 70, as the skin cells harden like old dry leather. It was very uncomfortable physically, the sensation of unyielding, tight dryness. Then I read the good reviews on this particular product, RoC Retinol Correction Deep Wrinkle Night Cream. I thought, Why not try it - it's not too pricey and I could afford this. So glad I did! Almost immediately it began to work wonders! My skin feels normal again, like tender, soft, clean young skin - well, as soft as a 70 year old can get. My skin looks and feels better after only a week's worth of bedtime application. No lines are disappearing, but they appear softer, if that makes sense. My makeup glides on more smoothly and my skin looks distinctly softer/better, more luminous. I would definitely recommend this one for the over 65 crowd. Note: There is a mild burning after its applied. At first, apply it every other night. Then apply every night. After the application dries down on your face, in 10 minutes or so, you can apply a natural, healthy none toxic moisturizer. It helps to relieve some of the burning.

extraits.titre: It works! Not a huge fan of the smell, but it is worth it.
extraits.texte: I’ve been using the night cream and daily moisturizer with SPF in addition to my regular after shower moisturizer. I use it every other day, as instructed. In the past two weeks, I gave noticed MASSIVE improvements in my skin - glow, hydration, oiliness and dryness (yay for combo skin that has changed as I have gotten older). I was sad that I had forehead wrinkles and really bad under eyes at 26, largely due to not taking care of my skin in my teens/early 20s when I thought I was invincible. However, this product has *changed* my skin for the better. I will say that the smell is a downside. It has a very strong fragrance that is “grandmotherly” in perfume. However, I’ve gotten more used it it. I did notice tingling after the first use, but haven’t noticed it since at all. Consistency is key with this product.
